name: Bad Blood
description:
Once per rest: Roll Spirit vs Spirit against a creature within medium range. On a win, that creature checks a Condition. On a loss, its next attack roll against you is favored.

Either way, you check a Condition.
successes:
✨: On a loss, no effect.

🌞: Repeat the roll, with the same effects. Check another Condition.

💀: Check an additional Condition.
